message.content: {"items":[{"item_id":"e045","prompts":["这个 review thread 我之前点过 resolve,后来又发现那个 race condition 还在,帮我把它重新打开吧。","PR 里那个关于 error handling 的讨论,我误 resolve 了,麻烦把 status 改回 unresolved 让我再回一下。","帮我把 #482 这个 pull request 上已经 resolve 的那条 review thread reopen 一下,我还有新的 comment 要加。","我 resolved 那条 thread 之后 reviewer 又提了新的 concern,需要把它变回 unresolved 状态,你处理一下。","把我刚才 resolve 掉的那条关于 memory leak 的 review thread undo 一下,我还要继续讨论。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e046","prompts":["Our payment service keeps hitting deadlocks under load — explain the main concurrency-control approaches and which protocol family would reduce blocking conflicts.","Two transactions read the same row, both update it, and the second commit silently overwrites the first one's write. What is this isolation anomaly called and how do databases prevent it?","Can you walk me through the difference between optimistic concurrency control and multiversion concurrency control, and when each is a better fit?","I'm designing a queue table where workers claim jobs, and I'm seeing phantom reads when new jobs appear mid-transaction. How do serializable isolation levels like SSI handle this?","Reviewing a database course assignment: what does serializability actually guarantee, and how do conflict and dependency graphs prove a schedule is correct?"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e047","prompts":["我已经做完全局运动补偿了,现在需要根据帧间差异生成动态目标的二值掩码,结果请保存成稀疏矩阵的格式。","帮我对这段补偿后的视频序列提取前景运动区域,输出要求是 CSR 表示的 mask,方便后续存储和传输。","写个脚本,从补偿后的两帧图像里找出发生变化的目标区域并生成 mask,用压缩稀疏行格式存储每个 mask。","视频里的摄像机抖动已经校正过了,接下来要标记出画面中真正在移动的物体,掩码数据我想用稀疏格式保存,你来实现一下。","帮我把运动补偿之后的残差图转成动态物体的 binary mask,并且只存非零元素,用 CSR 形式输出。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e048","prompts":["我手上有一个 three.js 的 scene graph,里面用了 InstancedMesh 做重复零件,帮我把每个 instance 展开成单独的 mesh 再按部件分组导出。","这个 Three.js 场景层级太乱了,我想把不同的 part 拆开,每个 link 单独导出一份 OBJ 文件,顺便生成 URDF 用于机器人仿真。","帮我把场景里烘焙好的 mesh 数据解析出来,然后做 part partitioning,每个部分导出成 OBJ,最后组装成一个带关节的 URDF 模型。","我需要把这个用 three.js 建的装配体转换成 URDF,要求先把 InstancedMesh expand,再按 link 划分导出各个 OBJ。","写个 pipeline:读取 three.js 的场景文件,做 mesh baking,把实例化的几何体展开,然后按部件切分并逐个导出 OBJ 和 URDF。"],"rubric":[]},{"item_id":"e049","prompts":["I have a folder of about 200 product photos — batch resize them all to 1200px wide and save them as JPEG quality 85.","Can you blur out the license plate in this image and crop the result to a square before saving it?","Flip this scanned document image horizontally — the scan came out mirrored — and also strip the EXIF metadata.","Take this screenshot and add a subtle gaussian blur to the background edges so the centered logo stands out more.","I need to rotate these photos 90 degrees, crop off the black borders the scanner added, and convert them from TIFF to PNG."],"rubric":[]}]}
